svg.title: Where things are stored and who writes them
svg.desc: A matrix of twenty-two stores against the code that writes them: the Host writes the pedalboard files, banks, last pedalboard and profiles; the Session owns the preferences and the recorder; the webserver writes favourites, user files, identity and settings; mod-host writes plugin state; the OS image writes identity and system files.
svg.metadata:
GENERATED by docs/mod-ui/diagrams/src/build.py from specs.py (persistence). Do not edit this file by hand. Content of the diagram as Mermaid or plain data (a summary for readers and AI tools; the layout lives in specs.py):
%% W = writes (and reads back), r = reads, x = only deletes %% store | where | host | session | webserver | libmod_utils | mod-host | subprocess | OS image %% Manifest and TTL | ~/.pedalboards/<name>.pedalboard/ | W | . | W | r | . | r | W %% addressings.json | in the bundle | W | . | . | . | . | . | . %% snapshots.json | in the bundle | W | . | . | . | . | . | . %% Plugin state | in the bundle (state_save) | . | . | . | . | W | . | . %% Screenshot, thumbnail | in the bundle | . | . | r | . | . | W | . %% LV2 plugin bundles and presets | ~/.lv2/ | W | . | W | r | W | W | . %% banks.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | W | . | W | . | . | . | . %% Factory banks | /usr/share/mod/banks.json | r | . | . | . | . | . | W %% last.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | W | . | . | . | . | . | . %% prefs.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | W | W | W | . | . | . | . %% profile1..5.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | W | . | . | . | . | . | . %% favorites.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | . | . | W | . | . | . | . %% Thumbnail port cache | <DATA_DIR>/.cache/ | . | . | . | . | . | W | . %% user-id.json | <DATA_DIR>/ | . | . | W | . | . | . | . %% tokens.conf | <DATA_DIR>/ (unused by the UI) | . | . | W | . | . | . | . %% License keys | keys/<sha1 of the plugin URI> | . | . | x | r | . | . | . %% Tag, uid, RSA key, server key | DATA_DIR in development, image on a device | . | . | r | . | . | . | W %% User files (NAM, IR, audio) | /data/user-files/ | . | . | W | . | r | . | . %% Marker files and signals | /data/*, /root/* | . | . | W | . | . | . | W %% Hardware descriptor, release | /etc/mod-* | r | . | r | . | . | . | W %% Recording and playback | /tmp/capture.ogg, playback.ogg | . | W | . | . | . | W | . %% Plugin state while running | <DATA_DIR>/pedalboard-tmp-data | x | . | . | . | W | . | .
svg.text: Tag, uid, RSA key, server key
DATA_DIR in development, image on a device
Everything is a file. Most JSON goes through TextFileFlusher (write to .tmp, fsync, rename), but prefs.json can be saved without it and favorites.json is written both ways.
Nothing in this repository writes the license keys or the device identity: the OS image provides them (in development, server.py invents a dummy identity).
A cross in a cell: only deletes it
